pyramiding_rule: Strictly prohibit adding positions within 15 minutes or 2.0 points of an existing losing trade; zero pyramiding into falling/rising momentum wicks.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Require a confirmed multi-timeframe volume-weighted average price (VWAP) cross and an ATR-normalized volatility filter before any XAUUSD order is executed.
profit_harvest_threshold: Aggressively trigger partial profit locks at +$10.00 and full structural harvest at +$20.00 to prevent floating profits from evaporating.
